commandRunner.$comment: Left out of the per-mutant command, all run by ci.yml on every push: test/real (its real-SQLite interruption sweep takes about 80 s a run), and the three files that start real child processes, runner.test.ts (runner.ts is not under mutation), system-children.test.ts (system.test.ts covers the same rules with stand-in runners) and camoufox/install-children.test.ts (install.test.ts covers the planner with stand-ins): a bailed worker killed while it starts a child can leave the child stuck in the kernel (PR #11)
commandRunner.command: pnpm exec vitest run --coverage.enabled=false --bail=1 --exclude test/exec/runner.test.ts --exclude test/exec/system-children.test.ts --exclude test/camoufox/install-children.test.ts test/plan test/services test/setup test/exec test/commands test/camoufox
